--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 4m16s | run 20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf | 5 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Out-of-order stats responses: an older, slower response overwrites the newer range
   where: /stats (GET /api/stats/harvests)
   expected: After changing From to 2025-01-01 and then quickly to 2026-07-01, the page shows stats for 1 Jul 2026 - 31 Dec 2026
   saw: {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026","Best plants","NO. 1","Tomato","1.35 kg · Sungold","View","Tomato","NO. 2","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 3","Lettuce","350 g · Little Gem","View","Lettuce","Weight by plant and month","2.9 kg total","Harvest weight per plant and month, 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026","PLANT\tAUG 2025\tJUN 2026\tJUL 2026\tAUG 2026\tSEPT 2026\tTOTAL","Courgette\t–\t–\t1.2 kg\t–\t–\t1.2 kg","Lettuce · Little Gem\t–\t200 g\t–\t–\t150 g\t350 g","Tomato · Sungold\t300 g\t…
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf/probes/race.mjs (expectation "newest-range-wins")
2. MEDIUM Malformed or unexpected stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats...'
   where: /stats
   expected: A visible error when the stats response is malformed or empty, and no uncaught error
   saw: {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato","1.05 kg · Sungold","View","Tomato","NO. 3","Lettuce"],"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf/probes/client-faults.mjs (expectation "change-malformed-shows-error")
3. MEDIUM Clearing To with a From date after this year gives a misleading 'From must be on or before To' error
   where: /stats
   expected: An empty To date is either accepted as an open end or refused with a reason about the empty field
   saw: {"fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2027-03-01"},{"label":"To","value":""}],"alerts":["5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","The From date must be on or before the To date."]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf/probes/inputs.mjs (expectation "from-only-range-not-rejected")
4. MEDIUM Months with no harvests are left out of the per-month table
   where: /stats?from=2025-01-01
   expected: The table has a column for every month in the chosen range (or at least between the first and last harvest), so gaps show up as empty months
   saw: ["PLANT\tAUG 2025\tJUN 2026\tJUL 2026\tAUG 2026\tSEPT 2026\tTOTAL","Total\t300 g\t200 g\t1.65 kg\t600 g\t150 g\t2.9 kg"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf/probes/inputs.mjs (expectation "months-without-harvest-shown")
5. LOW    After a failed load, the old range summary stays next to the error
   where: /stats
   expected: When loading a new range fails, only the error shows, or the summary matches the selected range
   saw: ["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-184454-hunt-ccbf/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "range-text-not-stale-on-error")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
